title: Tarang - Cultural Fest 2025
description: The annual cultural extravaganza of IIIT Lucknow featuring dance, music, drama, and art competitions. Students from across colleges participated in this vibrant celebration of talent and creativity.

title: TechNova - Tech Summit 2025
description: A two-day technology summit featuring workshops on AI/ML, web development, and cybersecurity. Industry leaders shared insights and students showcased innovative projects.

title: Khel Mahotsav - Sports Day 2025
description: The inter-department sports championship featuring cricket, football, basketball, athletics, and indoor games. A celebration of sportsmanship and campus spirit.

title: HackIIIT - 24hr Hackathon 2024
description: A 24-hour hackathon where teams of 4 built solutions for real-world problems. Categories included HealthTech, EdTech, and FinTech with prizes worth ₹50,000.

title: Utsav - Annual Fest 2024
description: The flagship annual festival of IIIT Lucknow with celebrity performances, fashion shows, stand-up comedy, and food stalls. Three days of non-stop entertainment.

title: CodeWars - Coding Contest 2024
description: An intense competitive programming contest with 200+ participants. Three rounds of algorithmic challenges tested problem-solving skills and coding speed.
